title: Certificates of Deposit: entry thresholds for opening each tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers the entry thresholds that a customer must meet to open each tier of the Certificates of Deposit line: the minimum age, the deposit range, and the per-tier limit on open certificates.

## Definitions

- **Minimum age to open** is the youngest age, in whole years on the opening date, at which a customer may open the tier.
- **Minimum opening deposit** is the smallest opening deposit accepted for the tier, in USD.
- **Maximum principal** is the largest principal a single certificate of the tier may hold, including add-ons, in USD. It is also the most the opening deposit may be.
- **Open certificates of this tier** is the most open certificates of the tier that one customer may hold.

## Entry thresholds by tier

| Tier | Minimum age to open (whole years) | Minimum opening deposit (USD) | Maximum principal, including add-ons (USD) | Most open certificates of this tier per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 18 | 500.00 | 1000000.00 | 5 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 18 | 5000.00 | 500000.00 | 2 |
| 12-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | 5 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 18 | 2500.00 | 1000000.00 | 3 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | 5 |
| 60-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | 5 |

## Entry gate of each tier, as a checklist

For every tier, a new certificate of that tier may be opened only when all of the following hold:

1. the customer's age is at least the tier's minimum age to open;
2. the opening deposit is at least the tier's minimum opening deposit;
3. the opening deposit is at most the tier's maximum principal;
4. the customer's count of certificates of that tier is below the tier's limit on open certificates.

Where a tier requires new money for its opening deposit, its entry gate also admits new money only.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical deposits)

| Tier | Hypothetical opening deposit | Within the tier's deposit range? |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 500.00 USD | Yes, it equals the minimum |
| 6-Month Certificate | 499.99 USD | No, it is below the minimum |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 500000.00 USD | Yes, it equals the maximum |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 500000.01 USD | No, it is above the maximum |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 2499.99 USD | No, it is below the minimum |

## Points of judgement

**A customer already holds two open 11-Month No-Penalty Certificates. May a third be opened?**
No. The count of that tier would have to be below 2, and it already equals 2.

**A customer holds three open 18-Month Bump-Up Certificates and wants a 12-Month Certificate. Does the bump-up count stop it?**
No. The per-tier limit counts only certificates of the requested tier; the 12-Month Certificate limit of 5 is judged on the customer's 12-Month Certificates alone.

**Does the maximum principal only matter at opening?**
No. It is the largest principal a single certificate of the tier may hold including add-ons, so it remains a ceiling after opening.
